_doc: The player's own animals that go about with them: dogs, cats, hawks — and the riding horse (player.mount, bridged in as one of them). systems/animalCompanions.js keeps them (player.animalCompanions); ui/innerMapPets.js walks them on the street map; ui/animalsPanel.js shows them, the market's kennel and the Who Walks With You panel. Days: a year is 120 days. hungerPerDay: how much of a full belly (100) a day costs. eats: what of your packs it will eat and how much each unit fills. forage: what it finds itself a day, in a town or out in the wild (a cat mouses, a hawk takes its own game, a horse grazes outside winter). board: gold a day for scraps or fodder at a town's market when you have nothing it eats (paid to the town's purse). lifeYears: [min, max] years it lives. effects: modest, scaled by the animal's fitness (bond, belly, health) and read by the game: huntQty (the hunt's chance of an extra cut: player/foraging.js), huntItems (only those quarry items), theftWarn (a cutpurse noticed: systems/npcTheft.js awareness), roadWarn (fleeing a band on the road: player/roadEncounters.js), beastGuard (the share of a beast's mauling it takes on itself when you have no army), mouser (larder spoilage cut where it is kept: player/household.js), streetFight (its bite on the street map beside you: ui/innerMapPets.js through the escort's strike). breeds: variants with their own price, look and effect multipliers. sprite: the sheets drawn on the street map (data/animals.json layout: 4 rows up/left/down/right, a frame per column); spriteFrom: borrow an animals.json species' sheets.

hound.name: Hunting Hound
hound.desc: A scenthound bred to the chase: a nose for game.

mastiff.name: Mastiff
mastiff.desc: A great heavy guard dog: thieves and wolves think twice.

sheepdog.name: Sheepdog
sheepdog.desc: A clever herding dog: quick to warn, slow to bite.

mutt.name: Mutt
mutt.desc: A dog of no breed in particular, and every breed a little.

tabby.name: Tabby Cat
tabby.desc: A striped mouser from a granary's litter: rats keep clear of a larder it lives by.

goshawk.name: Goshawk
goshawk.desc: A falconer's goshawk, manned and flown to the fist: rabbits, hares and fowl for the pot.

falcon.name: Peregrine Falcon
falcon.desc: A noble's falcon: the swiftest stoop in the sky, a lord's pride.

riding.name: Riding Horse
riding.desc: Your mount: more movement each day and room in your packs.

lines.starving: {name} is starving: nothing in your packs it will eat, and no coin for scraps.
lines.ranOff: {name}, half-starved and long neglected, slipped away in the night and did not come back.
lines.oldAge: {name} died in the night, old and grey, after {years} years.
lines.boarded: You paid {cost}g at the market to feed {names}.
lines.strayJoins: The stray wolfs the last of it, licks your hand — and won't leave your heel. You name it {name}.
lines.strayWary: The stray snatches the food and backs off, watching you. It wants more before it trusts you.
lines.warnedThief: {name} barks at a hand near your purse.
